scripts.text:
[Local Villager]
Have you finished hunting the 50 Demon Pungus?
scripts.translation:
[當地村民]
你打完了50只天邪鬼嗎？

scripts.text: Yes
scripts.translation: 是

scripts.text: No
scripts.translation: 否

scripts.text: I want to quit
scripts.translation: 我想放棄

scripts.text:
[Local Villager]
Hmm, I don't think you've hunted 50 yet...
scripts.translation:
[當地村民]
嗯，我覺得你還沒打夠50只...

scripts.text:
[Local Villager]
Remember, I need help hunting Demon Pungus so go and hunt 50 of them.
scripts.translation:
[當地村民]
記住，我需要你幫忙打天邪鬼，所以去打50只吧。

scripts.text:
[Local Villager]
Are you sure that you want to stop hunting?
Any progress that you've made will be erased
scripts.translation:
[當地村民]
你確定要停止狩獵嗎？
你目前的進度將會被清除。

scripts.text: Yes
scripts.translation: 是

scripts.text: No
scripts.translation: 否

scripts.text:
[Local Villager]
Ok then, well come back here if you change your mind.
scripts.translation:
[當地村民]
好吧，如果你改變主意了，隨時回來找我。

scripts.text:

Please kill 50 Demon Pungus.
scripts.translation:

請擊殺50只天邪鬼。

scripts.text:

Amazing, you did that with speed.
scripts.translation:

真厲害，你完成得真快。

scripts.text: What did you need?
scripts.translation: 你需要什麼？

scripts.text:
[Local Villager]
I had my doubts, but you have proven me wrong.
scripts.translation:

我本來有些懷疑，但你證明我錯了。

scripts.text:
